subject.title: feat: expose model pricing to plugins via runtime.usage API

question: Should OpenClaw expose the raw `resolveModelCostConfig` and `estimateUsageCost` helper signatures as the stable `api.runtime.usage` plugin SDK contract?
rationale: This PR promotes internal pricing helper signatures into a public plugin runtime namespace, which automation should not lock in without maintainer API-boundary intent.

options.title: Accept API And Repair Coverage
options.body: Accept `api.runtime.usage` as proposed, then require the lazy reflection key, reflection test, and SDK API baseline updates before merge.

options.title: Narrow The SDK Surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller DTO/helper contract if the raw internal helper signatures are too broad for third-party plugins.

options.title: Pause For SDK Direction
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer chooses the permanent plugin pricing API shape.

recommendation.title: Pause For SDK Direction
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer chooses the permanent plugin pricing API shape.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to steipete across both usage pricing helpers and plugin runtime reflection, making this the best available API-boundary decision owner.
